ja325:1.1: Samaṇaṃ taṃ maññamāno upagañchiṃ asaññataṃ, so maṃ daṇḍena pahāsi yathā assamaṇo tathā.
ja325:2.1: Kin te jaṭāhi dummedha, kin te ajinasāṭiyā, (Dhp. v. 394.) abhantaran te gahanaṃ, bāhiraṃ parimajjasīti.
ja325:3.1: Ehi godha nivattassu, bhuñja sālīnaṃ odanaṃ, telaṃ loṇañ ca me atthi pahūtaṃ mayha pipphalin ti.
ja325:4.1: Esa bhiyyo pavekkhāmi vammīkaṃ sataporisaṃ, telaṃ loṇañ ca kin te si ahitaṃ mayha pipphalin
